KA SHAD RAID MARNGAR : Ban shu ia- thuh tang shaphang ka rukom jingshad khiem da iathuh ci-ei khyrd^at-khjnsoit shaphang ka rngop (background) kaba don ha lyndet jong ka Shad Raid Marngar kan long lehse kaba lymboit-lym- biang. Ki jingleh niam kiba ki briew ki pyndcp ka dei ha kajuh ka por ba ki khar Assamia ki rakhe ia ka ‘Rongali Bihu’. Ka niam-ka rukom ka neh haduh arphew sngi bad ki pynkut ia ka ha kajah ka sngi ba pynkut ia ka Rongali Bihu. Kane ka jingpynjlan haduh arphew sngi ka long ban ai lad ia kita ki musikir lane ki samla shyn- rang ki bym pat shong kurim ba kin ia rung ia mih na kawei ka Ing sha kawei pat kum ka d‘ik jong ka jingsngew ieit. Dei ruh ha kaba thoh poitri ba u nongthoh u pynpaw ha ka dur ka ba shai ia kaei-kaei kaba fiapoh jong u, kaba long ka bynta k.i ba kongsan jong ka jingim ka jong u, ia kaba la pynwun- dur da kiei-kiei ki ba u la ioh pateng na ki longshuwa-m an shuwa lyngba ki kmie-ki kpa bad ka kynhnn im-lang sah-Iang (Society) ha kaba ki la im. Kane kham burtsien ka pher na kawei ka jaitbynriew sha kawei pat. Haba u Kipling u thoh : “For East is East and West is West/and ne’er the twain shall meet” u’m shym da pynpaw eh ba kawei ka jaitbyn- riew ka kham khraw ne kham poh ban ia kawei pat hynrei u mut ba’n ong ba don ka jingiapher ha ka rukom pyrkhat handeng ki jaitbynriew ki ba iapher, khamtam haba ki ia long jngai. Wat hapdeng jong ngi ki ’riewlum ki ba shong ha kine ki thain bad ki bym da iashong jngai than ruh, don ki jingiapher ha ki ba bun ki liang ha

ka bam ka dih, ha ka kup ka sem ne ha ka jingsngew jong ngi shaphang kane ka Jingim hi. Ka jingsngew u Khasi shaphang ka Imhok- Jmsot, shaphang ki lynti ki ba pher ha ki ba ka jingsniew ka lah ba’n wan rung ; shaphang u Sohpetbneng bad u Dicngiei — ka long salonsar hapoh kane ka pyrthei jong u.
